Take a look here:

https://groups.google.com/forum/?fromgroups=#!searchin/shiny-discuss/sync$20to$20glimmer/shiny-discuss/AhyRlWHRqQk/RGHUFaRZFq8J

If you want to get data on to the server you can use sftp or rsync.

You can copy and paste data into a text area and ready it with cpdat <- read.table(header=T, text=input$tr_copyAndPaste)

HTML("<label>Copy-and-paste data from Excel</label>"),
tags$textarea(id="tr_copyAndPaste", rows=3, cols=40, ""),

You could link to data on dropbox and provide shiny with the url.
